rows.text: It seems I've gathered all the stone tablets.
Let me see... That's right, distinguished guest, this is the entire manuscript of the prophet. The golden thread can extract more information from it.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Now, perhaps it's time to reveal the full scope of Lady Aglaea's plan to you.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: It began with a small-yet-noble ideal: to resist the black tide. To be precise, to survive it.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: The esteemed guest is already aware of the devastation the black tide has wrought upon the land of Amphoreus. Neither humans nor strange beasts can survive its influence, only one thing is an exception.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: That's right. I believe the esteemed guest has also witnessed that the weavers are able to temporarily resist the invasion of the black tide. While they cannot move freely within it, the black tide indeed cannot completely engulf them.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: This is the first step from nothing to something. If we can uncover the secrets behind the weavers' mystery, one day, the people of Amphoreus will no longer fear natural disasters.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: But according to the current calculations, the number of nymphs required for the plan is far greater than what we can find. I have no idea where to obtain the remaining nymphs.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Regardless, thank you for your continued assistance.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker
